Feed: Bottom tab bar label: the endless video feed. Max ~10 characters.
Explore: Bottom tab bar label: browse clips by topic. Max ~10 characters.
Vocab: Bottom tab bar label: the learner's saved words and flashcard reviews. Max ~10 characters.
Profile: Bottom tab bar label. Max ~10 characters.
New: Word level name: a word the learner just saved.
Recognized: Word level name: the learner starts to recognise the saved word.
Familiar: Word level name: the learner remembers the word for days.
Almost known: Word level name: remembered for a week or more.
Known: Word level name / button: the learner already knows this word (no more reviews).
Ignored: Word level name: the learner chose to never review or underline this word.
Learning: Word level group name: words the learner is currently learning.
Learn again: Flashcard button: put a known word back into learning.
Forgot: Flashcard self-grade button: I did not remember the word.
FORGOT: Flashcard result stamp (uppercase): did not remember. Keep uppercase if the script has case.
Remembered: Flashcard self-grade button: I remembered the word.
REMEMBERED: Flashcard result stamp (uppercase): remembered. Keep uppercase if the script has case.
Explain: Word-card tab: an explanation of the word in this clip's context. Short tab label.
Explained: Label: this line has an explanation.
Large: Text size option / home-screen widget size.
Aa: Icon-like label for subtitle display options. Keep exactly "Aa".
Stay: Button in the 'Leaving already?' exit dialog: stay in the app.
Daily: Reminder frequency option: a reminder every day.
Minimal: Reminder frequency option: only when the streak is at risk.
Romaji: Romanized Japanese. Use the standard term in the target language.
Hiragana: Japanese syllabary. Use the standard term in the target language.
Katakana: Japanese syllabary. Use the standard term in the target language.
Show furigana: Furigana = small kana readings above kanji. Use the standard term.
Lessons: Topic name for clips that teach Japanese.
Learner: Default display name when the learner has no name.
Account: Section title / support topic: the learner's account.
A clip or word: Support topic: a problem with a video clip or a word.
Somewhere else: Onboarding answer to 'Where did you hear about Kizuki?'.
A friend: Onboarding answer to 'Where did you hear about Kizuki?'.
Google search: Onboarding answer to 'Where did you hear about Kizuki?'.
Drill apps: Onboarding answer: apps the learner tried before (gamified drill apps).
Flashcards: Onboarding answer: methods the learner tried before.
now: Inserted into 'Next practice {when}' as {when}: the next review is now.
in the morning: Inserted into 'Next practice {when}' as {when}: later today, in the morning.
Next practice {when}: {when} is a phrase such as 'tomorrow', 'in 3 days', 'now', 'in the evening'.
Next practice: {when}: {when} is a phrase such as 'tomorrow', 'in 3 days', 'now', 'in the evening'.
{month} {year}: Calendar heading; {month} is the localized month name. Reorder if the language writes year first.
Try for $0.00: Main button that starts the free trial. Local currencies differ, so do NOT write a currency amount: say 'Try for free' naturally.
Save 58%: Discount badge on the yearly plan.
Save {n}%: Discount badge on the yearly plan, e.g. Save 58%.
Widget page headline, first line; second line is 'Every time you look.'
Widget page headline, second line after 'A little Japanese.'
the moment it clicks: Brand tagline under the logo 気づき (kizuki = the moment you notice/realise). Short and poetic.
Kizuki the fox: Alt text for the fox mascot image named Kizuki.
common: Dictionary tag: a commonly used word.
adverb (と): Part-of-speech label: adverb taking the particle と. Keep と.
expression: Part-of-speech label in the dictionary: set expression / phrase.
counter: Part-of-speech label in the dictionary: counter word.
numeric: Part-of-speech label in the dictionary: numeral.
copula: Part-of-speech label in the dictionary: copula (だ/です).
godan verb: Part-of-speech label: Japanese godan (u-) verb. Use the term Japanese teachers use in the target language.
ichidan verb: Part-of-speech label: Japanese ichidan (ru-) verb. Use the term Japanese teachers use in the target language.
Binge Learner: Playful achievement badge name. Short and fun.
Half Hour Hero: Playful achievement badge name (studied 30 minutes). Short and fun.
Hour of Power: Playful achievement badge name (studied 60 minutes). Short and fun.
On a Roll: Playful achievement badge name (3-day streak). Short and fun.
One Week Strong: Playful achievement badge name (7-day streak). Short and fun.
Unstoppable: Playful achievement badge name (30-day streak). Short and fun.
Word Collector: Playful achievement badge name (saved 10 words). Short and fun.
Word Hoarder: Playful achievement badge name (saved 50 words). Short and fun.
Getting Fluent: Playful achievement badge name. Short and fun.
Blue line · new word: Legend: words underlined in blue are new.
No line · known word: Legend: words without an underline are known.
Card front: Setting: what the flashcard front shows.
Premium active: Status: the Premium subscription is active.
Keep Premium: Button keeping the subscription when the learner considers cancelling.
Restore purchase: App store: restore a previous purchase.
Store not available: The App Store / Google Play billing is not available.
Watch original: Open the original video on YouTube.
Welcome [back]: Text inside [ ] is highlighted in orange; keep exactly one [ ] pair around the highlighted word(s).
Save your [progress]: Text inside [ ] is highlighted in orange; keep exactly one [ ] pair around the highlighted word(s).
heard as [{word}]: Shown under a word: the tapped form as heard in the clip. Keep [ ] around {word}.
Literally: [{lit}]: Literal translation of a line. Keep [ ] around {lit}.
Meaning: Word-card tab: dictionary meaning. Short tab label.
Examples: Word-card tab: example sentences. Short tab label.
Notes: Word-card tab: the learner's own notes. Short tab label.
{channel} · Watch on YouTube: Link that opens the clip on YouTube. Keep the brand YouTube.
